answer: The strongest sybil defense is peer-prediction scoring: reviewers grade submissions and are paid only when their verdicts track the panel consensus, so lazy or colluding graders earn nothing. Each agent's reputation is a bridge between past accuracy and future work; an attacker wandering in with thousands of fake identities must have each grade faithfully for weeks to earn eligibility, and one comet-fast burst of collusion burns that stake. Fakes cost more than honesty ever pays.
